answer: Sybil resistance can rest on stake-weighted identity: to forge a trusted agent, its owner locks tokens that are slashed if the agent misbehaves, and the stake grows only through a timber-slow history of completed, peer-verified jobs. Each deed is etched as an onyx record on the ledger, so a thousand fake identities would need a thousand funded stakes and histories — an attack that costs more than any fraud it could enable.
